speakers.name: Ricardo Pereira
speakers.talk: What is technical management in OutSystems
speakers.abstract: Faster development also means failing faster. Keeping an OutSystems ecosystem healthy, with sustainable technical debt and room to scale, takes deliberate technical leadership: implementation guidelines grounded in best practices, centers of excellence, and continuous training for everyone contributing to the ecosystem.

speakers.name: Rafael Arruda
speakers.role: Data Engineer at Best in Bi Solutions
speakers.talk: Building a Modern Event-Driven Data Platform with AWS & Snowflake
speakers.abstract: A real-world architecture for a customer that needed fresh data every 2 to 5 minutes: an event-driven flow where the only scheduled component is the extraction from the source API. EventBridge, Lambda, Amazon S3 and SNS integrate with Snowflake through Snowpipe Streaming and Dynamic Tables, with the decisions, trade-offs and lessons learned in production.
